normal.name: Geek Hobbies
normal.text: 🎮 FINISHED: DUKE NUKEM 1 - EVERCADE Unlike the most popular games in the series, this one is not an FPS, but a 2D platformer released in 1991, with that feeling of MS-DOS games from the 90s. I loved playing it on the Evercade, which lets you play it with retro graphics or the remastered version. A game divided into 3 episodes, with a good number of levels divided between them. Have you played Duke Nukem 1? If not, I recommend everyone to try this classic at least once. #finished #dukenukem #retrogaming #evercade #geekhobbies

normal.name: Raindrac
normal.text: I’m beginning to grow a fond appreciation for the GameCube now that I’m playing a lot of my old games on the Steam Deck. It’s just pure gaming! No gimmicks, dead servers or predatory micro-transactions. Everything just works. And it’s not as antiquated as games often are on older consoles, either, so it strikes a sweet spot that no other Nintendo console does. #gaming #retrogaming #gamecube #nintendo

normal.name: 狐
normal.text: This game is just disappointing start to finish. Bland BGM and level design, combat is utterly boring too. Multiple playable characters is cool but they suck and there's almost no reason not to pick Rogue. Playing this makes you want to skip as much as possible just to end it faster. Some potentially good ideas in here, none of which were realised. Skip this and Gamemaster's Legacy. I'll have to revisit the first X-Men to see if it's good enough... #retrogaming #sega #gamegear
